posts.author: Crozeph
posts.body: Is it possible to replicate TWEWY (The World Ends With You) in RPG maker MV? I really love the aesthetic of the game which is why I want to replicate it

posts.author: AquaEcho
posts.body:
The closest thing would be Moghunter's LMBS plugin which is meant to replicate the Tales battle system.
MV – Linear Motion Battle System
MOG Linear Motion Battle System Ver 0.32b (2021/05/01) Sistema de batalha linear com movimentação livre onde a ação acontece em tempo real, baseado no sistema de batatha da serie Tales. COMMANDS Z …
mogplugins.com
RPG Maker is not designed for fast paced action games. The creators have separate engines for those types of games (Pixel Game Maker or its sequel Action Game Maker). Or look into any general purpose game engine which is better equipped to handle those types of games.

posts.author: AquaEcho
posts.body:
This guide will help you make a phone menu
Eventing a Picture-Based Menu | The Official RPG Maker Blog
The default RPG Maker menu works well, but sometimes you want one that fits your game’s aesthetic better or offers only the important options. Eventing your own picture-based menu is a great way to make sure your menu fits your game, so let’s take a look at how to make one.
www.rpgmakerweb.com
What you're describing is still far easier and faster to do in another (general purpose) engine. Here's a rule of thumb: the further away you get from RPG Maker's default template systems, the more work it is and less support you'll find in creating it, and less reason there is to use RPG Maker in the first place.
RPG Maker uses top down tile based, grid based map movement. TWEWY does not. RPG Maker is not built for that kind of gameplay.
